note: City of Alma RV park at the edge of downtown, on a rise above the marshy west end of Harlan County Lake; open water is about 1 km south across the flats. Mostly seasonal: on the city's 2021 map 28 of 38 spaces are seasonal and 9 are transient. Wi-Fi is limited. --Claude
summary: Season Apr 15-Oct 15, full hookups (water/sewer), 38 spaces with pull-throughs 1-8, showers/Wi-Fi/dump confirmed on the city's pages; booking changed to first-come only with a booking.note (seasonal spaces by lottery). Fees $28 (2025 sheet) left as stored. Mostly seasonal (9 transient of 38) but passes the five tests; Google 4.1 (44). Not waterfront kept: water ~1 km away.
flags: MOSTLY SEASONAL, passes the five tests (report, not a drop on my reading): the city's map (dated 11-1-2021) colours 28 of 38 spaces 'Seasonal', 1 'Caretaker or Seasonal' and 9 'Transient' (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 22, 23, 26), i.e. ~24% nightly. The city leads with 'a limited number of campsites that are available on a first come first serve basis' and fills the rest by a fall lottery. Tests: (1) $28/night incl. tax (2025 rate sheet) - pass; (2) nightly rate posted on the city's own site with phone, first come first served, no application - pass; (3) no minimum - pass; (4) 9 of 38 nightly, over 1 in 10 - pass; (5) not a home community - pass. Google 4.1 from 44 reviews, so not the under-4 auto-drop. I don't read it as iffy: a city-run park with posted rules and rates. A human may still prefer to drop it for the small transient share.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, contrary operator claim: the city's page says 'To the south is a view of Harlan County Lake'. On Esri imagery the park sits on a rise at the edge of town and the open lake water is ~0.9-1 km south across marsh and exposed flats (the lake's west end, in drawdown). Far past any lakeview bound; a distant view across the flats only. Lead, no change.
ELECTRIC 50 A (derived) not confirmed: the city says only 'Full hookups (water-sewer-electric)'; amperage unstated. Left as stored.
